hooks.command: cmd=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); dir=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oP '(?<=-C )\S+' | head -1); if [ -z "$dir" ]; then dir=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oP '^\s*cd \K\S+' | head -1); fi; dir="${dir:-.}"; remote=$(git -C "$dir" config --get remote.origin.url 2>/dev/null); branch=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if echo "$remote" | grep -qi 'nix-configs' && [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Commits to main are blocked in nix-configs -- create a worktree + branch and open a PR instead (see CLAUDE.md Workflow Rules)."}}'; fi

cmd=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); dir=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oP '(?<=-C )\S+' | head -1); if [ -z "$dir" ]; then dir=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oP '^\s*cd \K\S+' | head -1); fi; dir="${dir:-.}"; remote=$(git -C "$dir" config --get remote.origin.url 2>/dev/null); gitdir=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir 2>/dev/null); commondir=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); if echo "$remote" | grep -qi 'nix-configs' && [ "$gitdir" = "$commondir" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"git push from the primary nix-configs checkout is blocked -- all work happens in a worktree (see CLAUDE.md Workflow Rules)."}}'; fi

file=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$file" ] && [ "${file##*.}" = "nix" ]; then root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$file")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$root" ]; then (cd "$root" && nix fmt -- "$file") >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; fi
